note: Non-LEGO parts of the LEGO station. Electronics are NOT repeated here: they are the items with these ids in night-array/kit/parts.json. The two monitors are the owner's own.

items.product: VIVO Single Monitor Desk Mount STAND-V001C (black) / STAND-V001CW (white)
items.role: carries one monitor each: steel pole, tilt bracket, C-clamp (or grommet bolt)
items.dims: pole 17.7 in (450 mm) x ~35 mm dia; 17.6 lb (8 kg); VESA 75 + 100; desk 10-88 mm (clamp)

items.product: Aluminium flat bar 1/8 in x 3/4 in x 48 in (6063), e.g. Everbilt / Hillman
items.url: any hardware store (Home Depot / Lowe's / Ace metal rack)
items.role: stiffener in the frame's bottom beam (slot 8 mm wide x 19.2 mm high); no cutting

items.product: Aluminium flat bar 1/8 in x 3/4 in x 36 in (6063)
items.role: stiffener in the frame's top beam, centred on the web between the screens; no cutting

items.product: 4 x M4 male-female hex stand-off 22 mm (steel or brass) + 4 x M4 x 10 screws
items.role: brings the thinner monitor's glass forward into the same plane (stand-offs: left 0 mm, right 22 mm)

items.product: self-adhesive felt sheet 1 mm, A4, x2 (shared with the dock)
items.role: dock liners (see ../dock/README.md); dots inside the bezel corners; side liners in an opening when the stud grid leaves more than 4 mm (left 2 mm, right 0 mm per side)

items.product: EVA craft foam 3 mm sheet + 1 mm foam tape (shared with the dock)
items.role: plug pocket pads (dock); pads on the retaining lips (left 6 mm, right 0 mm thick); foam collars between pole and neck cheeks; 2 mm foam under each Qi pad

items.product: 3M Bumpon SJ5023 (in kit/parts.json: feet) or thin felt dots
items.role: optional: under the floor plates on a slippery desk

electronics_in_kit_parts_json: power_strip (outside, behind/under the desk: it does not fit inside)
monitor_cords (only for a monitor with an internal PSU)
